4828.title: Codex SSE completion incorrectly depends on EOF
4828.rootCauseOneLine: The SSE reader records completed output but ignores terminal events and continues reading until EOF or deadline.
4828.proposedFix: Stop at successful completion or [DONE], cancel the reader, and preserve final-output preference, delta fallback, and empty-output validation.
4828.caveats: The source stream bug is reproduced twice; its role in the original live five-second title timeout remains unverified.
